decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper keeps its own page in its second year and fits the firm's core construction-equipment line, so there is no shortfall against aspiration that would trigger problemistic search.
The articulated dumper is a core product category for this established manufacturer and is still prominently presented, which points to satisfactory performance.

The rescue vehicle's downgrade from its own page to a mere mention suggests results below aspiration, but as a niche mining safety product with long sales cycles the firm is likely to carry it on slack for another year.
The compact telescopic loader keeps its own page and fits the construction range, so nothing signals a shortfall that would prompt dropping it.
The material lift is reported as the most popular rental lift and has just won a large order, so it clearly exceeds aspirations.
The mining loader logged 1,000 hours in its first seven months and has its own page, which is a strong early result above aspiration.
